metadata.title: Chig Okonkwo Misses Practice on Wednesday
metadata.description: Washington Commanders tight end Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) was not at the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday, according to Tashan Reed of The Athletic. Okonkwo suffered a hamstring injury in the Week 1 loss to the division-rival Philadelphia Eagles and was unable to play in last week's loss to the division-rival Dallas Cowboys. In Okonkwo's absence on Sunday in Dallas, tight ends Ben Sinnott and Colson Yankoff combined for two catches for 20 yards, while John Bates did not see a single pass-game target. The 27-year-old Okonkwo had a case for a 2026 breakout in his move to D.C. with quarterback Jayden Daniels (elbow), but that is not looking so hot after Okonkwo's hamstring injury in Week 1 and Daniels' dislocated left elbow in Week 2. Even if Okonkwo makes his return in Week 3 this Sunday against the Seattle Seahawks, he will be best left on the bench in deeper leagues with veteran Marcus Mariota taking over at QB.

metadata.title: Chig Okonkwo - Not practicing to begin week
metadata.description: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn implied that Okonkwo (hamstring) will be a non-participant for Wednesday's practice, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.
metadata.analysis: Quinn noted that Okonkwo will be in rehab mode to kick off Week 3 prep, which suggests that the tight end won't mix into drills Wednesday. Okonkwo is still tending to a hamstring injury that kept him from playing during this past Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

metadata.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
metadata.description: Chig Okonkwo remained absent from practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Okonkwo did not play last week. His status remains up in the air heading into Week 3.

metadata.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) ruled out for Week 2
metadata.description: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) has been ruled out for Week 2 for the Washington Commanders against the Dallas Cowboys according to John Keim.
metadata.analysis: Okonkwo has been unable to practice throughout the week for head coach Dan Quinn and will not suit up against the Cowboys. Ben Sinnott and John Bates will receive increased snaps for the Commanders in Week 2.

metadata.title: Chig Okonkwo - Ruled out this week
metadata.description: Okonkwo (hamstring) won't play Sunday at Dallas, Tashan Reed of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Okonkwo didn't practice this week but was spotted with the rehab group Friday. He left Washington's Week 1 contest late in the third quarter, which allowed John Bates to play 70 percent of snaps in the fourth quarter (Ben Sinnott took 45 percent, while Colson Yankoff played only five percent). Bates figures to again play the most snaps Week 2 at Dallas, but he may be subbed out for Sinnott or Yankoff in some passing situations.

metadata.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) not seen practicing Friday
metadata.description: Chig Okonkwo was not seen practicing on Friday.
metadata.analysis: Okonkwo did not practice last week. He should be ruled out when the official injury report is released.

metadata.title: Chig Okonkwo Ruled Out for Week 2
metadata.description: Washington Commanders tight end Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 2 matchup with the Cowboys, according to team senior writer Zach Selby. Okonkwo exited his Commanders debut, a season-opening loss to the Eagles, after making two catches for 16 yards, and he has been unable to practice all week leading up to a second consecutive divisional matchup. Head coach Dan Quinn told the assembled media on Friday that Okonkwo is working hard and the team will reassess his status next week when Washington hosts the reigning Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks.

metadata.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) officially a non-participant Thursday
metadata.description: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: The veteran tight end missed another practice session on Thursday due to his hamstring injury, and it looks likely to leave him sidelined for Sunday's game against Dallas. Fantasy managers should expect John Bates to get more work if Okonkwo is ruled out ahead of game time.

metadata.title: Chig Okonkwo - Goes down as non-participant Thursday
metadata.description: Okonkwo (hamstring) is officially listed as a non-participant at Thursday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Okonkwo has missed Washington's first two practices ahead of a Week 2 clash with the NFC East rival Cowboys. The offseason acquisition was injured in his Commanders debut against the Eagles. John Bates would take on an expanded role if Okonkwo sits out Sunday against Dallas, with more snaps likely available for Ben Sinnott as well.

metadata.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) not seen at practice Thursday
metadata.description: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) was not seen at Washington's practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Okonkwo was not spotted during the early portions of Thursday's practice, meaning he is more than likely going to be a non-participant on their injury report. That puts him on track to miss Sunday's game against the Cowboys, which would lead to more work for John Bates in that matchup.
